ios.//: Every value here comes from the client's Apple accounts, which do not exist yet (see docs/go-live/01-credentials-checklist.md). Filled from EAS secrets rather than committed: ascAppId is the numeric App Store Connect id, appleTeamId the 10-character team id. `expo-apple-app-specific-password` is NOT used — an App Store Connect API key (.p8) uploaded to EAS is what lets CI submit without a human.

android.//: serviceAccountKeyPath points at the Google Play service-account JSON. Store it as an EAS file secret, never in the repo. `internal` is deliberate: the first upload of a new package name has to go to a testing track, and production is promoted from the Play Console once the store listing is complete.
